\section{Scoped flux cancellation}\label{app:scoped-flux-cancellation}

\subsection{Scope}\label{app:scoped-flux:scope}

This appendix records symbolic support for finite Stokes with separately typed A$\Omega$D pressure-resolved flux values. The scope is a finite declared region $R$ and boundary/window $B=(\partial F,\omega)$.

\subsection{Scoped pairing and Stokes residual}\label{app:scoped-flux:statements}

\paragraph{Setup.}

\[
\varphi_{ij}\mapsto\varphi_{ij}(B),\qquad\varphi_{ij,\AO}(B)=p^D_{ij,\AO}(B)A_{ij,\AO}(B).
\]

\paragraph{Derivation.}
The scoped boundary pairing is retained through the AFC Stokes identity:

\begin{equation}\label{app:scoped-flux:eq:afc-pairing}
\sum_{i\in R}\operatorname{div}(i;B)=\sum_{\substack{i\in R\\j\notin R}}\varphi_{ij}(B).
\end{equation}

The Stokes residual is

\begin{equation}\label{app:scoped-flux:eq:residual}
\mathcal{E}(R,B)=\sum_{i\in R}\operatorname{div}(i;B)-\sum_{\substack{i\in R\\j\notin R}}\varphi_{ij}(B).
\end{equation}

A valid declared scope has $\mathcal{E}(R,B)=0$.

\subsection{Falsification}\label{app:scoped-flux:falsification}

If the symbolic residual is nonzero, the declared scope has a missing channel, sign error, incomplete boundary, or undeclared sheddic path.
